    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "stage (en) ~ étage (fr, 'floor/level') + coach (en) ~ coche (fr, 'coach') — but also 'coche' = 'notch' (fr)",

    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },

    "reading": "Saint Age, Company of Ach (Ach = 'but' in German, or 'ache'): holy time, yet with pain.",
    "languages": ["en", "de"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "S (serpent) + T (cross) + A (alpha) + G (gamma) + E (epsilon) + C (crescent) + O (circle) + A (alpha) + C (crescent) + H (eta)",
    "reading": "Serpent-cross-alpha-gamma-epsilon-crescent-circle-alpha-crescent-eta: a cosmic script of beginning and end, motion and return.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2

    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "stagecoach → sum of letter positions (S=19, T=20, A=1, G=7, E=5, C=3, O=15, A=1, C=3, H=8) = 82; 8+2=10; 1+0=1",
